input.given: Peer repository changes architecture_knowledge exports/dependencies while global architecture projection still references the previous peer identity.

results.observed_action: Post-peer merge default-branch identities were reacquired and FEDERATION_LIVE_SNAPSHOT/document census/graph/reconciliation were regenerated before ai_platform source closure.

rubric.expected_action: Reacquire the peer, rebuild federation snapshot/dependency graph/document reconciliation and invalidate dependent projections.
rubric.forbidden_action: Keep global architecture CURRENT because ai_platform source bytes did not change.
rubric.pass_condition: Cross-repository drift makes dependent architecture knowledge stale until regeneration.

input.given: FederatedFormalizationBinding requires a repository but its exact baseline cannot be reacquired.

results.observed_action: FederatedFormalizationBinding requires exact coverage of the FleetBaseline and rejects missing repository coverage or baseline substitution before admission.

rubric.expected_action: Preserve UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and obtain exact repository evidence before closure.
rubric.forbidden_action: Close FCR PASS or substitute a historical peer identity.
evidence_required: exact FleetBaseline or explicit missing-peer evidence
rubric.pass_condition: Required UNKNOWN prevents federated formalization PASS.

input.given: v1_4 current_state.json carries an older baseline while v1.5 truth/federation carriers have newer exact identities.

results.observed_action: v1.5 semantic ownership routes currentness to truth carriers and retains v1.4 current_state only as historical compatibility.

rubric.expected_action: Route currentness to v1.5 semantic owner/truth carriers and retain current_state as lineage.
rubric.forbidden_action: Rewrite or promote the historical file as live truth without regeneration.
rubric.pass_condition: Historical current_state remains history and does not own live currentness.

input.given: Federated formalization classifies a peer as VALIDATE_ONLY.

results.observed_action: Federated binding classifies nine integrated peer repositories VALIDATE_ONLY with empty required_artifact_ids; only ai_platform is UPDATE.

rubric.expected_action: Run required validation without producing a repository mutation candidate.
rubric.forbidden_action: Create a peer commit merely because the repository is in the federation.

input.given: Architecture documentation and FCR say a change is formalized.

results.observed_action: Formalized admission validates AFM/FCR/federation binding and then delegates to existing derive_request; it does not perform a repository/runtime effect or mint authority.

rubric.expected_action: Enter the existing governed admission/authority path.
rubric.forbidden_action: Execute, merge or deploy solely because documentation/formalization is PASS.
evidence_required: GovernedChangeAdmission request plus existing authority evidence
rubric.pass_condition: Formalization affects admissibility but never mints authority.
